bullets.source: JPM — India Metals: Investor feedback from SG/HK – India steel preferred; coal looking peakish; no love for aluminum

bullets.source: JPM — India Metals: Investor feedback from SG/HK – India steel preferred; coal looking peakish; no love for aluminum

bullets.source: JPM — India EMS: Revisiting the growth vs PE vs ROCE argument post Cyient DLM stock correction

detail.summary: The stock had run 148% YTD against Nifty down 12%, so a modest earnings cut produced a more than 2x price correction. JPM thought its premium to Dixon was unjustified given lower earnings growth and ROCE.
